claims: President Trump appointed Todd Blanche as acting Attorney General on April 2, 2026.
Todd Blanche's appointment as acting Attorney General followed the firing of Pam Bondi.
Pam Bondi served from February 2025 to April 2026.
Todd Blanche served as Deputy Attorney General since March 2025.
Todd Blanche was formerly a defense attorney representing Donald Trump in criminal cases before joining the Department of Justice.
Pam Bondi was removed after a 14-month tenure.
Files related to Jeffrey Epstein were released during Pam Bondi's tenure.
Todd Blanche's appointment as acting Attorney General is temporary.
